reuse.why: Reuses getCategoryAverage, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable registration, and introduces getFillableCategories and fillMonth that the averages, setZero and the new action share; copyPreviousMonth does not use them.

duplication.why: copyPreviousMonth re-states the hidden/template/#fixed exclusions inline next to getFillableCategories, the income-in-tracking check remains in both setZero and fillMonth, set3MonthAvg duplicates setFixedMonthAvg, and fillMonth's sign flip repeats setNMonthAvg's.

placement.why: Selection and fill helpers live in budget/actions.ts with the actions and the new handler is registered in budget/app.ts beside its siblings; the hidden rule is split between SQL in getFillableCategories and a JS check in copyPreviousMonth.

scope.why: All edits serve the four requested behaviours, plus tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Most actions now share one selector and one fill loop, but the exclusion rules exist in two forms (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth's inline condition) and the income rule is outside the selector, so the next exclusion must again be added in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth: applies the hidden/template/#fixed exclusions and the income rule inline on getBudgetData rows instead of going through getFillableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's combined condition re-expresses getFillableCategories' SQL hidden filter plus its template/#fixed filter in a different shape; set3MonthAvg is setFixedMonthAvg(month, 3) written out under another name.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is threaded into getFillableCategories (as a conditional SQL fragment) and fillMonth; copyPreviousMonth bypasses the shared selector with its own exclusion condition.
